WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items AS oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_item_average_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_invoice_line_items_per_order_item
FROM per_item;

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined, so that line item's ratio is skipped; COUNT still includes the line item.
